reader_summary.overview: I'm Patrick O'Shaughnessy, and this is Invest like the Best. This show is an open-ended exploration of markets, ideas, methods, stories, and of strategies that will help you better invest both your time and your money. You can learn more and stay up to date at investorfieldguide.com.

thesis: This episode argues that Ethereum represents a foundational, novel technology with vast future potential due to its ability to enable trustless transactions and decentralized stable coins like DAI. The speaker also highlights Coinbase as a successful business driven by real utility and growing user engagement regardless of price direction, while noting real-world adoption of blockchain by credible companies like DocuSign.

claims.claim: The speaker is a strong bull on Ethereum, citing its ability to enable trustless transactions and computations as a foundational technology with vast future potential.
claims.quote: And so, and I'm a, I should point out, I'm a strong bull on Ethereum, but my point in sharing this is actually that if the innovators themselves cannot exactly quantify the future value, how can investors, you know, even do that, right?

claims.claim: The speaker is personally most excited about Ethereum's ability to be a decentralized trustless form of interaction, which has applications to all sorts of things.
claims.quote: But that's actually specifically what personally I'm most excited about about Ethereum is its ability to truly be a decentralized trustless form of interaction, which has applications to all sorts of things.

claims.claim: The speaker is bullish on Ethereum because it represents a completely novel technology with no precedent, specifically regarding decentralized stable coins like DAI.
claims.quote: And I think that's amazing. So that's why I'm bullish on it. It's just clearly, and then when you look at, I actually have a newspaper clipping from the financial times from like six months ago when the recent crypto winter hit, where it said something like the, I'm going to ruin the title here, but it's something like questions over the utility of Ethereum rise as price plummets.

claims.claim: The speaker notes that Coinbase was a hugely successful business because people use it like crazy, and their usage was growing week over week regardless of price.
claims.quote: So Coinbase, obviously, has been a hugely successful business, largely because people use it like crazy. In the same way that Uber is amazing, because I've used it five times in the last two days, and it's indispensable to me.

claims.claim: One of the things that made the speaker bullish on Coinbase was that their usage was growing week over week, showing real utility regardless of price.
claims.quote: And then when you look within the current space, we're in like a crypto winter. It's a pretty bad one. And yet projects that have been around forever, like, Gallum, the decentralized compute network, usage has 5x in last year, despite the drop in price, like, 90%, or whatever, it has been.

claims.quote: In the same way that Uber is amazing, because I've used it five times in the last two days, and it's indispensable to me.

claims.claim: The speaker highlights that Coinbase's usage was growing week over week, indicating it is a real thing people get utility from, regardless of price direction.
claims.quote: Going back to the Coinbase example, one of the things that we really got as bullish is, like, no matter what the price was doing, their usage was growing, you know, week over week. That was phenomenal. It told us that this is a real thing that people get utility from, and it doesn't matter which way the price is going.

claims.claim: The speaker points to real adoption from blockchain by credible companies like DocuSign integrating with the Ethereum blockchain for e-signing.
claims.quote: You see real adoption from blockchain from real companies, you know, like DocuSign, I believe, announced an integration with the Ethereum blockchain for e-signing as a ledger for that.
